subject: Final week conversion: limited-time usage subsidy & 2-week trial extension
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greengrid.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@greengrid.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Mar 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — can you stretch trial credits through EOW?

Hi Vanessa,

Appreciate the demo last week — team is very excited about the latency improvements. We spooled a few more internal tests and have a spike in usage that will push past our trial cap before Monday.

Short version: would Redwood be willing to add a one-time usage credit (~$3k equivalent) and extend our trial window by two weeks? If we can get that runway through next week, we can validate production throughput and sign an annual commit. I can route a PO quickly.

Attached is a usage snapshot. Happy to take a quick call if needed.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of ML Platforms, GreenGrid AI
—
Attachment: GreenGrid_usage_snapshot_20250328.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Mar 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can you stretch trial credits through EOW?

Daniel — thanks for the note and the snapshot. Quick read: you did push a couple of high-throughput batches that explain the surge. Congrats on the fast progress.

I'm looping in Marissa (sales ops) and Karthik (pricing/finance) to confirm internal approvals. Tentative plan: 10k tokens credit (~$3k list) + 14-day trial extension, conditional on a signed PO or demo recap that confirms timelines. We usually do this as a one-time FY-end sweetener for close-ready accounts.

Can you confirm: (1) expected ARR if you go annual after validation, (2) who will sign the PO, and (3) any procurement timing constraints? If you can route a PO to procurement@redwood.com, we can fast-track.

If it's helpful, I'm free for a 20-min call today at 1pm PT to confirm details.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive — West
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Mar 2025 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can you stretch trial credits through EOW?

Adding the ops perspective — I reviewed GreenGrid's usage and the scoped pilot. Given they are commit-probable (sales notes + expected ARR ~ $180k), finance is comfortable with a one-time subsidy.

Approved terms I'd recommend: 10k USD equivalent in usage credits (applied to hosted tokens only), 14-day trial extension, and a clause that credits expire if no PO or signed MSA received within 30 days of credit issuance. We should also request a brief validation checklist to capture workloads they intend to run in production.

I can prepare the credit addendum and PO acceptance flow this afternoon. Karthik — can you confirm that accounting is okay with the 30-day clause and revenue recognition treatment?

—Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: GG_PO_Draft_20250329.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Mar 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can you stretch trial credits through EOW?

Marissa / Vanessa — finance reviewed. Confirming approval under these conditions: (1) credit capped at $10,000 gross, (2) credit applies only to hosted API usage (no marketplace/third-party add-ons), (3) requires PO or signed MSA within 30 days to prevent clawback, and (4) we document the credit in HubSpot deal GG-2025-031 for audit trail.

Once Marissa uploads the addendum, ops can apply the credit to the account. I'll notify accounting to mark it as promotional credit for Q1 adjustments.

Karthik
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greengrid.ai>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@greengrid.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Mar 2025 16:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can you stretch trial credits through EOW?

Daniel — good news. Finance and sales ops approved a one-time $10,000 usage subsidy + 14-day extension. Conditions: PO or signed MSA within 30 days, credit applies to hosted API usage only. Marissa will send the addendum and a short validation checklist this afternoon.

If you can route the PO to procurement@redwood.com, we’ll apply the credit the same business day after we receive the doc and get you the extended window. Appreciate the fast cycle here — excited to move this to production with GreenGrid.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive — West
Redwood Inference
